tools.name: make_game
tools.description: Make a small video game about one person with Playable Gift's game maker, from two or three specific things the sender told you about them, like habits or inside jokes. Ask the sender for the recipient's name and those details first if you don't have them. This returns at once while the game builds.

tools.name: get_made_game
tools.description: Check a game started with make_game. While it builds, this returns the stage and, once known, the title and cast. When state is complete, it returns shareUrl, the play link to give the sender so they can send it to the recipient, and manageUrl, a private link for the sender only. Never share manageU

tools.name: get_gift_catalog
tools.description: Read the requirements and limits for saving a game you wrote yourself with create_custom_game. You don't need this for make_game.

tools.name: create_custom_game
tools.description: This is the advanced path, so use make_game unless the sender asks you to write the game yourself. It saves a complete self-contained HTML game you wrote as a free private draft, and returns a preview link (previewUrl) and a private managementToken. tools.name: revise_custom_game
tools.description: Replace a draft saved with create_custom_game with a revised self-contained HTML game and details. Read the current HTML with export_gift, make the change in it, and pass expectedRevision so you don't overwrite another edit.

tools.name: get_gift
tools.description: Read a draft saved with create_custom_game, with its current revision, preview link and status, using its private managementToken. The game's HTML is not included; use export_gift for it.

tools.name: get_gift_history
tools.description: Read the last five revisions of a draft, without game HTML. They include personal content, so keep them private. Use export_gift with a revision number to read one revision's game.

tools.name: export_gift
tools.description: Export a draft as portable JSON with its complete self-contained game HTML, without the recipient's email address or private tokens. Pass revision to export one of the five kept revisions instead of the current one.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: make_game, revise_custom_game, get_gift, get_gift_history · Private data: get_made_game, create_custom_game, get_gift, get_gift_history, export_gift · Public sink: get_made_game, export_gift · Destructive: revise_custom_game.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: make_game, revise_custom_game, get_gift, get_gift_history · Private data: get_made_game, create_custom_game, get_gift, get_gift_history, export_gift · Public sink: get_made_game, export_gift · Destructive: revise_custom_game

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
